name: Toady
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level druid 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (living or dead toad)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

As baleful polymorph, except the duration is not permanent. The target need not make a Will save to see if it succumbs to the curse. Also, the new form cannot prove fatal to the creature.
